displayProperties.description:
Training (1 of 6)

Apply Banes and complete objectives to increase your reward multiplier and your score!

Complete the activity with a high enough score to earn a B Grade Reward Packageto continue.
displayProperties.name: Training (1 of 6)

displayProperties.description:
Training (2 of 6)

Complete challenges to increase your reward multiplier further.

Complete the activity with a high enough score to earn a B Grade Reward Package to continue.
displayProperties.name: Training (2 of 6)

displayProperties.description:
Training (3 of 7)

Apply Boons to increase your Guardians capabilities, while reducing your reward multiplier.

Complete the activity with a high enough score to earn a B Grade Reward Package to continue.
displayProperties.name: Training (3 of 6)

displayProperties.description:
Training (4 of 6)

Beat the clock to increase your score! The more time left on the clock at the end, the higher your Score Bonus. 

Complete the activity with a high enough time bonus to earn an A Grade Reward Package and earn some Bonus Drops on other Ops activities to continue.
displayProperties.name: Training (4 of 6)

displayProperties.description:
Training (5 of 6)

Use Player Stakes to put yourself at a disadvantage but greatly increase your reward multiplier.

Equip the Locked Loadout Player Stake, then earn an A Grade Reward Package to continue.
displayProperties.name: Training (5 of 6)

displayProperties.description:
Training (6 of 6)

Prove you have what it takes to stand shoulder to shoulder with other Guardians. 

Equip the No HUD Player Stake, then earn an A Grade Reward Package to complete your training!
displayProperties.name: Training (6 of 6)
